_meta.note: EXAMPLE answer bank. Copy to answer_bank.json and fill with YOUR verified answers during ./setup.sh. Every value must be true for you — the pipeline never invents what is not here.

answers.education: YOUR verified education — never represented as a degree it is not

compensation_expectation.rule: posted-band midpoint or defensible market median; computed per role from its posted band
compensation_expectation.note: If the form offers bands, pick the band containing the computed figure. Never exceed the posted band top.

team_size.rule: Select the smallest available band. If free-text exact number is required, leave blank and report.
team_size.note: Never type an invented exact headcount into a free-text field.

years_leading.rule: Select the band containing your verified leadership tenure. If bands differ, pick the band containing it.
years_leading.note: Only claim tenure you can truthfully support; document the rule you follow.

gates.eeo_mandatory_no_decline: STOP and report — never answer a mandatory EEO question with no decline option.
gates.free_text_unverifiable: STOP that field and report — never invent qualifications, dates, degrees, metrics, team sizes, or compensation.
gates.no_ai_attestation: STOP and park — never attest materials are unaided own work.
gates.travel_attestation: STOP and ask the applicant — never attest to travel/relocation commitments.
